name: Thumbnail Agent
description: Internal thumbnail generator with brand-specific templates and fonts, natural script-based scenes guided by up to four separate person references, and PNG download.
composition_rules: Every brand prompts all featured people with front-facing heads, visible eyes, and direct eye contact with the camera, with or without reference photos.
Script and extra-prompt instructions may change the scene and body pose but cannot override head or gaze direction.
Every final rendered option is checked for gaze and visibility; reference-based results also receive a visible-feature appearance review after the gaze check passes.
Gaze and appearance failures share one retry, allowing at most two generation attempts per thumbnail from the original references when supplied.
Unavailable or malformed checks stop creation without another generation, and the browser hides results without successful required checks for all options.
CLI --subject-image requires configured OpenAI for one final camera-facing check of the supplied scene.
person_reference_notes: Upload one photo per person, up to four references; the next upload appears after each selection.
Every reference displays its original thumbnail and filename and can be replaced or removed before generation.

All selected references are supplied together in order to OpenAI visual planning and image edits. The edits use OPENAI_PERSON_IMAGE_MODEL (default gpt-image-2.5-sunburst-2026-09-08) and OPENAI_PERSON_IMAGE_QUALITY (default high).

Each person's facial proportions, hair, and distinguishing features guide identity while the scene, body pose, expression, and clothing can follow the script; heads and eyes stay directed toward the camera.
There are no local cutouts, pasted-photo layers, or intact-photo fallback. The existing server OpenAI key is used throughout; no additional API key is required.

Scenes without references use OPENAI_IMAGE_MODEL (default gpt-image-2.5-sunburst-2026-09-08) and OPENAI_IMAGE_QUALITY (default medium); existing general-model overrides do not change the independent person-reference defaults.

GPT Image 2-family models generate a 1152x2048 scene in a 9:16 aspect ratio; the branded PNG remains 1080x1920. High-quality reference edits and the dedicated appearance-review call may increase API cost and generation time.
Reference controls are locked during a job, and the browser requires the reported reference count, edit strategy, and successful appearance review for the overall result and every returned thumbnail.

The appearance review uses OPENAI_PERSON_REVIEW_MODEL (default gpt-6-astra), independently of the visual-planning and gaze model OPENAI_MODEL. It compares each reference against the final thumbnail for visible face shape, eyes and brows, nose and mouth, hair, glasses, and sufficient clarity; optional jewelry may change.

The appearance review assesses edit quality without identifying anyone or proving an exact identity match. It can miss changes, and exact likeness is not guaranteed by image generation; review all faces and hair before use.
Identical image content cannot be uploaded twice; different photos may share a filename.
security_notes: Do not share your personal OpenAI API key.
Each copied app should use its own OpenAI API key or a separate company-managed key.
Anyone with access to the hosted link can use the app unless they add their own access control.
usage_notes: Leverage Edu uses three headline lines, with the last highlighted turquoise; use MY JOURNEY TO | UNIVERSITY OF | SALFORD to choose the line breaks.
Optionally upload one separate reference photo per person, starting with Upload image 1 and continuing up to four people.
Review every person's face, hair, and placement in the generated scene when references were supplied.
